# Explicit Linux process cold and portable qualification

This family uses the explicit `hepta.hia.linux-process.v1` profile. Ordinary
Core and the earlier Linux stdio profile continue to reject its startup and
stderr operations. The reference `LinuxStartupSnapshot` remains caller data;
it cannot grant native kernel, compiler, cold or default-selection authority.

## Admission and production

`tools/build_hia_linux_process_cold.py` accepts an actual matching-current-source
cold replay report. It reopens the original nested qualification, all three
actual B images and the complete current source map. The required source set
extends the complete existing Linux stdio cold domain with the process assets,
builders, retained controls, qualifier and this documentation.

Five bounded compiler calls produce P1, P2, P3, an ordinary B3 regression image
and the process entry packer. P1/P2/P3 must be byte-identical. Compiling the
ordinary selfhost source with P3 must reproduce the actual cold B3 bytes. Each
call retains its exact nine-field request, actual child stdout, full receipt,
full output, captured source and provider bytes. A program build separately
compiles one explicit checked process program and packs its actual image with
the captured entry packer. Its packed ELF has no interpreter, writable
executable mapping or executable stack. Publishing an ELF does not run it.

The caller-pinned development builder is retained as a separate entry point.
Its reports, image hashes and successful development observations do not supply
matching-current-source cold authority. The new cold builders reject missing,
failed, stale, extended or development-only admission before compilation.

## Permanent qualification

Run from the matching checkout:

```console
python -B tools/qualify_hia_linux_process.py --cold-report PATH --evidence NEW_DIRECTORY
```

The qualifier prepares the toolchain and eighteen original programs in an owned
process. It then runs these independent complete groups, preserving exact
ordered method IDs and start/stop events:

| Group | Methods | Observation |
|---|---:|---|
| Original public Source | 71 | Original stdio 18, Core program 21, assembly 18, process 14 |
| Direct process | 33 | Actual kernel executions and explicit reference VM results |
| Packer | 13 | Complete source/output/workspace bytes and all canaries |
| Startup refusal | 4 | Actual `prctl` and three `mprotect` refusal points |
| Entry boundaries | 4 | Buffer endpoints, raw string boundary and two kernel E2BIG refusals |
| Legacy output domain | 4 | Actual original B3 and P3 observations, eight compiler calls |
| Portable package | 1 | Actual sdist, wheel, install, explicit reference profile and missing resources |

The seven groups contain 130 methods. Cold preparation and every group retain
the original 180-second owner deadline and 3-second cleanup interval. Compiler
and direct child calls retain 20 seconds, 1 MiB compiler output/workspace,
10-second CPU, 256 MiB address-space and 8 MiB stack limits. Each original VM
case retains 10 million steps. The installed packaging commands retain their
existing 60-second limits inside the portable group's unchanged 180+3 owner.
There are no development, timeout, capacity, skip or expected-failure switches.

An ordinary observation failure does not skip later original groups. Actual
source or captured-input drift refuses further execution. The parent separately
reads complete child reports, exact request IDs, raw results, actual receipts,
all six anomaly sets, owned-process exit/deadline/cleanup and final fresh source
bindings. A partial discovery, skipped method, expected failure or missing
terminal cannot qualify.

The portable test builds and installs the actual package with all twelve
declared resource roles. It compares every installed resource byte, executes
the explicit reference profile with ordered raw argv/environment data and
stderr, checks ordinary/stdio rejection, removes each process asset in turn
and requires refusal without another checkout fallback, then restores and
rechecks. These installed VM observations are reference-only; they do not
stand in for native kernel or current-cold execution.

## Retained inputs and prior failures

`tests/fixtures/hia_linux_process_retained_controls.json` retains all original
authoring scripts, the original 71 IDs, every fixed case name and all eighteen
program inputs. Original raw custody is
`a66c166016fb9a7012bd45d257080c92ec9f5f27`; its source packet is
`0e11b2228ea61e9e0bacae7c841a8dccf95a9987`.

The first direct development group completed its 33 comparisons, then failed
when its additional packer comparison used different zero/A5 output preimages.
That original run stays FAIL. The retained thirteen-case packer successor uses
the same A5 preimage as the actual compile output and compares all bytes.

The first legacy-domain report's all-accepted assumption failed for explicit
empty exports: original B3 already refused those with code 68. The new process
compiler rejects that output domain with code 93 before function emission.
The permanent controls preserve this exact difference and the three originally
accepted legacy cases. They do not rewrite or upgrade the historical failure.

This qualification is specific to the explicit process family. It does not
activate a default backend, replace the whole CLI, eliminate hosted build/test
supervision, certify SQLite or close whole-native delivery.

def dump(path, value):

def install_refusal(kind):
    if kind == 'prctl':
        nr, arg = 157, 4
    elif kind == 'mprotect-stack':
        nr, arg = 10, None
    elif kind == 'mprotect-guard':
        nr, arg = 10, 0x801000
    elif kind == 'mprotect-cap':
        nr, arg = 10, 0x600000
    else:
        raise ValueError(kind)
    rows = [(0x20, 0, 0, 4), (0x15, 1, 0, 0xc000003e),
            (0x06, 0, 0, 0x80000000), (0x20, 0, 0, 0)]
    if arg is None:
        rows += [(0x15, 0, 1, nr), (0x06, 0, 0, 0x00050001)]
    else:
        rows += [(0x15, 0, 3, nr), (0x20, 0, 0, 16),
                 (0x15, 0, 1, arg), (0x06, 0, 0, 0x00050001)]
    rows += [(0x06, 0, 0, 0x7fff0000)]
    class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('code', ctypes.c_ushort), ('jt', ctypes.c_ubyte),
                    ('jf', ctypes.c_ubyte), ('k', ctypes.c_uint)]
    class Program(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('length', ctypes.c_ushort), ('filter', ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
    filters = (Filter * len(rows))(*(Filter(*row) for row in rows))
    program = Program(len(rows), filters)
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    lib.prctl.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]
    lib.prctl.restype = ctypes.c_int
    if lib.prctl(38, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS')
    if lib.prctl(22, 2, ctypes.addressof(program), 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_SECCOMP')
    return rows


def raw_exec(specification):
    """Run only as a fresh pre-exec helper; no profile code runs in this process."""
    spec = json.loads(Path(specification).read_text())
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    lib.execve.argtypes = (ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p),
                          ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p))
    lib.execve.restype = ctypes.c_int
    arrays = []
    retained = []
    for kind in ('argv_hex', 'environment_hex'):
        values = tuple(bytes.fromhex(s) for s in spec[kind])
        assert all(b'\0' not in value for value in values)
        retained.extend(values)
        array = (ctypes.c_char_p * (len(values) + 1))()
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            array[i] = value
        array[len(values)] = None
        arrays.append(array)
    image = Path(spec['elf']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(image) == spec['elf_sha256']
    for kind, size in ((resource.RLIMIT_CORE, 0), (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, 10),
            (resource.RLIMIT_AS, 256 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_STACK, 8 << 20),
            (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, 16 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, 32)):
        resource.setrlimit(kind, (size, size))
    signal.signal(signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIG_IGN if spec['sigpipe_ignored'] else signal.SIG_DFL)
    for fd in spec['close_fds']:
        os.close(fd)
    if spec.get('deny') is not None:
        install_refusal(spec['deny'])
    result = lib.execve(os.fsencode(spec['elf']), arrays[0], arrays[1])
    error = ctypes.get_errno()
    # This distinct file records a failure before payload entry, even when fd2
    # deliberately closed/broken. Never relabel it as a HIA program outcome.
    dump(Path(spec['exec_failure']), {'returncode': result, 'errno': error,
        'payload_entered': False, 'stage': 'raw_execve'})
    os._exit(125)

        'sigpipe_ignored': bool(ignored), 'close_fds': closed, 'deny': mode[5:] if mode.startswith('deny-') else None,
        'exec_failure': str((folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').resolve())}
    dump(folder / 'EXEC-REQUEST.json', spec)
    pipes = []
    read_end = None
    capacity = None
    started = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False

            (folder / 'stderr.bin').open('wb') as err:
        target_out = out
        target_err = err
        if mode in ('broken-stdout', 'broken-stderr', 'short-stderr'):
            read_end, write_end = os.pipe()
            pipes.extend((read_end, write_end))

            if mode.endswith('stderr'):
                target_err = write_end
            else:
                target_out = write_end

def reference(program, argv, environment, *, stdin=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False,
              short_capacity=None):
    from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE, READ, LinuxStartupSnapshot, LinuxProcessSignal
    from hepta.hia_program_runtime import execute_program, HIAProgramTrap

    stdout = []
    stderr = []
    def provider(request):
        nonlocal consumed
        if request.operation == READ:
            if mode == 'closed-stdin':
                return -9, b''
            data = stdin[consumed:consumed + request.count]

        expected_stderr_hex=b''.join(stderr).hex(), stdin_consumed=consumed, process_returncode=rc)
    return result

"""Complete retained process controls bound to a freshly admitted cold fixture."""
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import struct

from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE
from hepta.hia_program_runtime import _Machine, _Owner, _View
from tools import hia_linux_process_cold as custody
from tools.build_hia_linux_process_program import _elf_structure
from tests.hia_linux_process_cases import direct, reference, dump, sha
from tests.hia_linux_process_buffer_observer import native as observe_buffers
from tests.hia_linux_process_startup_fault_observer import direct as fault_direct

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CAPACITY = 1048576
MAGIC = int.from_bytes(b'HIALNXE2', 'little')

def encoded(argv, env):
    return (struct.pack('<QQQ', 3546416430321002824, len(argv), len(env))
            + b''.join(struct.pack('<Q', len(x)) + x for x in argv + env))


def definitions():
    rows = []
    def add(name, prog, argv=(b'process',), env=(), data=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False,
            rc=0, stdout=b'', stderr=b'', vm_argv=None):
        rows.append(dict(name=name, program=prog, argv=argv, env=env, data=data, mode=mode,
            ignored=ignored, expected_rc=rc, expected_stdout=stdout, expected_stderr=stderr,
            vm_argv=argv if vm_argv is None else vm_argv))
    # Linux's actual argc==0 exec entry is checked independently using the small
    # count program; this kernel-normalized one-empty-arg is not a profile filter.
    add('kernel-empty-vector-count', 'counts', argv=(), rc=0,
        stdout=struct.pack('<QQ', 1, 0), vm_argv=(b'',))
    for name, args, env, vmargs in (
        ('empty-vectors-kernel-entry', (), (), (b'',)),
        ('explicit-empty-arg', (b'',), (), (b'',)),
        ('ordered-raw-duplicates', (b'process', b'', b'\xff\xfe\n', b'x=x'),
         (b'B=two', b'A=one', b'A=three', b'', b'NO_EQUALS', b'\xff=\x80'), None),
        ('raw-no-utf8-and-newlines', (b'\xff', b'\x01\n\x7f\x80'),
         (b'\xfe', b'=', b'X=\n\xff'), None),
        ('large-aggregate-over-1MiB', (b'process', b'x' * 64000),
         tuple(bytes([65 + i]) * 64000 for i in range(18)), None),
    ):
        exact = args if vmargs is None else vmargs
        add(name, 'inspect', argv=args, env=env, vm_argv=exact,
            stdout=encoded(exact, env), stderr=b'\xff\0\n')
    add('fd2-three-raw-bytes', 'stderr', stderr=b'\xff\0\n')
    add('fd2-closed-full-negative-EBADF', 'stderr', mode='closed-stderr', rc=93)
    add('fd2-inherited-default-SIGPIPE', 'stderr', mode='broken-stderr', rc=-signal.SIGPIPE)
    add('fd2-inherited-ignore-full-EPIPE', 'stderr', mode='broken-stderr', ignored=True, rc=94)
    add('fd2-zero-open', 'stderr-zero')
    add('fd2-zero-closed-still-EBADF', 'stderr-zero', mode='closed-stderr', rc=93)
    add('fd2-exact-1MiB', 'stderr-short', stderr=b'Z' * 1048576)
    add('fd2-nonblocking-short-write', 'stderr-short', mode='short-stderr', rc=95, stderr=None)
    for name in ('invalid-argv-index', 'invalid-env-index', 'copy-invalid-source',
                 'copy-invalid-destination', 'copy-source-overflow', 'copy-destination-overflow'):
        add(name, name, rc=-signal.SIGILL)
    add('copy-zero-at-both-ends', 'copy-zero-end', argv=(b'last',))
    data = bytes(range(256)) * 4096
    # Retain the full 12 previous fd0/fd1 kernel scenarios under the new profile;
    # original fixture bodies and checks are separately retained unchanged.
    old = [
        ('empty-input', 'bounded-copy', b'', 'ordinary', False, 0, b''),
        ('short-binary-input', 'bounded-copy', b'\0\xffshort\n', 'ordinary', False, 0, b'\0\xffshort\n'),
        ('zero-count-open', 'zero-transfer', b'unchanged', 'ordinary', False, 0, b''),
        ('zero-count-closed-read', 'zero-transfer', b'unchanged', 'closed-stdin', False, 247, b''),
        ('zero-count-closed-write', 'zero-transfer', b'unchanged', 'closed-stdout', False, 247, b''),
        ('full-signed-read-ebadf', 'read-ebadf-exact', b'untouched', 'closed-stdin', False, 93, b''),
        ('full-signed-write-ebadf', 'write-ebadf-exact', b'untouched', 'closed-stdout', False, 93, b''),
        ('SIGPIPE-default', 'bounded-copy', b'pipe payload', 'broken-stdout', False, -signal.SIGPIPE, b''),
        ('SIGPIPE-inherited-ignore-EPIPE', 'bounded-copy', b'pipe payload', 'broken-stdout', True, 224, b''),
        ('exact-1MiB', 'bounded-copy', data, 'ordinary', False, 0, data),
        ('over-1MiB-rejected-before-write', 'bounded-copy', data + b'!', 'ordinary', False, 3, b''),
        ('bounds-before-read', 'out-of-bounds', b'untouched', 'ordinary', False, -signal.SIGILL, b''),
    ]
    for name, prog, raw, mode, ignored, rc, expected in old:
        add('retained-' + name, 'retained-' + prog, data=raw, mode=mode, ignored=ignored,
            rc=rc, stdout=expected)
    return rows


def retained():
    return custody.retained_inputs()


def case_source(name):
    row = retained()['programs'][name]
    raw = row['source'].encode('utf-8')
    custody.require(type(row['bytes']) is int and len(raw) == row['bytes']
                    and custody.digest(raw) == row['sha256'], 'retained program bytes differ: ' + name)
    return raw


def program_names():
    names = tuple(dict.fromkeys(case['program'] for case in definitions())) + ('buffer-layout',)
    custody.require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 18
                    and set(names) == set(retained()['programs']), 'complete eighteen programs required')
    return names


def checked_program(name):
    return assemble_program(case_source(name), profile=PROFILE)


def _program(fixture, name):
    row = fixture['programs'][name]
    custody.check_bindings([row['build']])
    path = Path(row['executable'])
    custody.require(custody.digest(path.read_bytes()) == row['executable_sha256'],
                    'prepared executable changed: ' + name)
    return row, path


def kernel_checks(case, actual, expected, build):
    stderr = case['expected_stderr']
    if case['mode'] == 'short-stderr':
        stderr = b'Z' * actual['pipe_capacity']
    return {
        'exec_entered': actual['exec_failure'] is None,
        'returncode': actual['returncode'] == expected['process_returncode'] == case['expected_rc'],
        'stdout': actual['stdout_hex'] == expected['expected_stdout_hex'] == case['expected_stdout'].hex(),
        'stderr': actual['stderr_hex'] == expected['expected_stderr_hex'] == stderr.hex(),
        'stdin_consumed': actual['stdin_consumed'] == expected['stdin_consumed'],
        'no_timeout': actual['timed_out'] is False, 'reaped': actual['reaped_ECHILD'] is True,
        'elf_unchanged': actual['image_sha256'] == actual['image_after_sha256'] == build['executable_sha256'],
    }


def direct_case(fixture, output, index):
    case = definitions()[index]
    build, executable = _program(fixture, case['program'])
    folder = Path(output) / case['name']
    actual = direct(folder, executable, case['argv'], case['env'], stdin=case['data'],
                    mode=case['mode'], ignored=case['ignored'])
    expected = reference(checked_program(case['program']), case['vm_argv'], case['env'],
        stdin=case['data'], mode=case['mode'], ignored=case['ignored'], short_capacity=actual['pipe_capacity'])
    dump(folder / 'VM.json', expected)
    checks = kernel_checks(case, actual, expected, build)
    row = {'name': case['name'], 'status': 'PASS' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL',
           'checks': checks, 'native_returncode': actual['returncode'],
           'vm_steps': expected['steps'], 'effects': len(expected['effects'])}
    dump(folder / 'CHECKS.json', row)
    return row


def pack_frame(image):
    return struct.pack('<QQQQ', MAGIC, 1, len(image), 0) + image


def packer_definitions(image):
    valid = pack_frame(image)
    invalid = 0xffffffff
    space = 0xfffffffe
    return [
        ('same-A5-full-observation', valid, CAPACITY, 8192),
        ('empty-frame', b'', CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('wrong-magic', b'x' + valid[1:], CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('wrong-version', valid[:8] + struct.pack('<Q', 2) + valid[16:], CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('reserved-field', valid[:24] + struct.pack('<Q', 1) + valid[32:], CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('zero-image', pack_frame(b''), CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('truncated-frame', valid[:-1], CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('trailing-byte', valid + b'!', CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('zero-output', valid, 0, space),
        ('short-output', valid, 8191, space),
        ('image-one-over-entry-limit', pack_frame(bytes(CAPACITY - 1024 + 1)), CAPACITY, invalid),
        ('exact-1MiB-ELF-structural-only', pack_frame(bytes(CAPACITY - 1024)), CAPACITY, CAPACITY),
        ('minimum-image-structural-only', pack_frame(b'\0'), 4096, 4096),
    ]


def packer_checks(raw, capacity, expected, values, reference, actual):
    checks = {'returned': actual['returncode'] == 0 and actual['child']['status'] == 'returned',
        'value': values == [actual['child']['result_u64']] == [expected],
        'full_source': actual['source_hex'] == reference['source_hex'] == raw.hex(),
        'full_output': actual['output_hex'] == reference['output_hex'],
        'full_workspace': actual['workspace_hex'] == reference['workspace_hex'],
        'all_canaries': all(actual['canaries']), 'no_timeout': not actual['timed_out'],
        'no_project_imports': actual['child']['forbidden_modules_loaded'] == [],
        'no_stdin_effect': actual['stdin_consumed'] == 0,
        'no_stdout_stderr': actual['stdout_hex'] == actual['stderr_hex'] == ''}
    if expected in (0xffffffff, 0xfffffffe):
        checks['refusal_before_output_mutation'] = actual['output_hex'] == (b'\xa5' * capacity).hex()
    return checks


def packer_case(fixture, output, index):
    build, _ = _program(fixture, 'counts')
    built = Path(build['build']['path']).parent
    image = (built / 'program.image.bin').read_bytes()
    packer = Path(fixture['packer_image']['path'])
    custody.check_bindings([fixture['packer_image']])
    name, raw, capacity, expected = packer_definitions(image)[index]
    roots = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(b'\xa5' * capacity)),
             _Owner(-3, bytearray(CAPACITY))]
    checked = assemble_program((ROOT / custody.PACKER_SOURCE).read_bytes())
    vm = _Machine(checked, 10000000, CAPACITY, None, 128)
    values = vm.invoke(vm.functions['f0'], [_View(roots[0], False),
                      _View(roots[1], True), _View(roots[2], True)])
    reference = {'values': values, 'source_hex': roots[0].data.hex(),
        'output_hex': roots[1].data.hex(), 'workspace_hex': roots[2].data.hex(),
        'steps': vm.steps, 'resources': vm.resources()}
    dump(Path(output) / (name + '.VM.json'), reference)
    actual = observe_buffers(Path(output) / name, packer, raw, b'\xa5' * capacity, bytes(CAPACITY), b'', 'ordinary')
    checks = packer_checks(raw, capacity, expected, values, reference, actual)
    if expected not in (0xffffffff, 0xfffffffe):
        elf = bytes.fromhex(actual['output_hex'])[:expected]
        inspection = _elf_structure(elf, raw[32:])
        dump(Path(output) / (name + '.ELF.json'), inspection)
        checks['W_X_and_exact_HIA_image'] = (inspection['writable_executable_segment'] is False
            and inspection['executable_stack'] is False and inspection['elf_interpreter'] is False)
    if name == 'same-A5-full-observation':
        checks['all_original_compile_output_bytes'] = actual['output_hex'] == \
            (built / 'packed.output.bin').read_bytes().hex()
    row = {'name': name, 'status': 'PASS' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL',
           'checks': checks, 'vm_steps': vm.steps, 'packed_synthetic_image_executed': False}
    dump(Path(output) / (name + '.CHECKS.json'), row)
    return row


def startup_case(fixture, output, index):
    mode = retained()['groups']['startup'][index]
    build, elf = _program(fixture, 'counts')
    actual = fault_direct(Path(output) / mode, elf, (b'process',), (b'A=1',),

    checks = {'ELF_entry_not_execve_failure': actual['exec_failure'] is None,

        'image_unchanged': actual['image_sha256'] == actual['image_after_sha256'] == build['executable_sha256']}
    row = {'name': mode, 'checks': checks, 'status': 'PASS' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL'}

def entry_case(fixture, output, index):

        build, elf = _program(fixture, 'buffer-layout')

            'stderr_two_workspace_endpoints': actual['stderr_hex'] == expected['expected_stderr_hex'] == '2122',
            'real_exec': actual['exec_failure'] is None, 'no_timeout': not actual['timed_out'],
            'reaped': actual['reaped_ECHILD']}
    elif index == 1:

            'stderr': actual['stderr_hex'] == expected['expected_stderr_hex'] == 'ff000a',

        folder = Path(output) / name

    if index >= 2:

def domain_case(fixture, output, index):

"""Independent kernel/VM observers for explicitly selected process-profile ELFs.

Python/ctypes only arrange execve's raw byte vectors in the child before exec.
The executed static ELF has no interpreter, Python, libc or ctypes dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import ctypes
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')


LIMITS = {'wall': 20, 'cleanup': 3, 'cpu': 10, 'address': 256 << 20,
          'stack': 8 << 20, 'filesize': 16 << 20, 'fds': 32, 'core': 0}



def install_refusal(kind):
    if kind == 'prctl':
        nr, arg = 157, 4
    elif kind == 'mprotect-stack':
        nr, arg = 10, None
    elif kind == 'mprotect-guard':
        nr, arg = 10, 0x801000
    elif kind == 'mprotect-cap':
        nr, arg = 10, 0x600000
    else:
        raise ValueError(kind)
    rows = [(0x20, 0, 0, 4), (0x15, 1, 0, 0xc000003e),
            (0x06, 0, 0, 0x80000000), (0x20, 0, 0, 0)]
    if arg is None:
        rows += [(0x15, 0, 1, nr), (0x06, 0, 0, 0x00050001)]
    else:
        rows += [(0x15, 0, 3, nr), (0x20, 0, 0, 16),
                 (0x15, 0, 1, arg), (0x06, 0, 0, 0x00050001)]
    rows += [(0x06, 0, 0, 0x7fff0000)]
    class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('code', ctypes.c_ushort), ('jt', ctypes.c_ubyte),
                    ('jf', ctypes.c_ubyte), ('k', ctypes.c_uint)]
    class Program(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('length', ctypes.c_ushort), ('filter', ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
    filters = (Filter * len(rows))(*(Filter(*row) for row in rows))
    program = Program(len(rows), filters)
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    lib.prctl.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]
    lib.prctl.restype = ctypes.c_int
    if lib.prctl(38, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS')
    if lib.prctl(22, 2, ctypes.addressof(program), 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_SECCOMP')
    return rows


def raw_exec(specification):
    """Run only as a fresh pre-exec helper; no profile code runs in this process."""
    spec = json.loads(Path(specification).read_text())
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    lib.execve.argtypes = (ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p),
                          ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p))
    lib.execve.restype = ctypes.c_int
    arrays = []
    retained = []
    for kind in ('argv_hex', 'environment_hex'):
        values = tuple(bytes.fromhex(s) for s in spec[kind])
        assert all(b'\0' not in value for value in values)
        retained.extend(values)
        array = (ctypes.c_char_p * (len(values) + 1))()
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            array[i] = value
        array[len(values)] = None
        arrays.append(array)
    image = Path(spec['elf']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(image) == spec['elf_sha256']
    for kind, size in ((resource.RLIMIT_CORE, 0), (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, 10),
            (resource.RLIMIT_AS, 256 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_STACK, 8 << 20),
            (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, 16 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, 32)):
        resource.setrlimit(kind, (size, size))
    signal.signal(signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIG_IGN if spec['sigpipe_ignored'] else signal.SIG_DFL)
    for fd in spec['close_fds']:
        os.close(fd)
    if spec.get('deny') is not None:
        install_refusal(spec['deny'])
    result = lib.execve(os.fsencode(spec['elf']), arrays[0], arrays[1])
    error = ctypes.get_errno()
    # This distinct file records a failure before payload entry, even when fd2
    # deliberately closed/broken. Never relabel it as a HIA program outcome.
    dump(Path(spec['exec_failure']), {'returncode': result, 'errno': error,
        'payload_entered': False, 'stage': 'raw_execve'})
    os._exit(125)


def direct(folder, elf, argv, environment, *, stdin=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False):
    folder.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    assert type(argv) is tuple and type(environment) is tuple
    assert all(type(x) is bytes and b'\0' not in x for x in argv + environment)
    raw = elf.read_bytes()
    (folder / 'stdin.bin').write_bytes(stdin)
    closed = {'closed-stdin': [0], 'closed-stdout': [1], 'closed-stderr': [2]}.get(mode, [])
    spec = {'elf': str(elf.resolve()), 'elf_sha256': sha(raw),
        'argv_hex': [v.hex() for v in argv], 'environment_hex': [v.hex() for v in environment],
        'sigpipe_ignored': bool(ignored), 'close_fds': closed, 'deny': mode[5:] if mode.startswith('deny-') else None,
        'exec_failure': str((folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').resolve())}
    dump(folder / 'EXEC-REQUEST.json', spec)
    pipes = []
    read_end = None
    capacity = None
    started = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False
    with (folder / 'stdin.bin').open('rb') as inp, (folder / 'stdout.bin').open('wb') as out, \
            (folder / 'stderr.bin').open('wb') as err:
        target_out = out
        target_err = err
        if mode in ('broken-stdout', 'broken-stderr', 'short-stderr'):
            read_end, write_end = os.pipe()
            pipes.extend((read_end, write_end))
            if mode.startswith('broken-'):
                os.close(read_end)
                pipes.remove(read_end)
                read_end = None
            else:
                capacity = fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_GETPIPE_SZ)
                fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_SETFL,
                            fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_GETFL) | os.O_NONBLOCK)
            if mode.endswith('stderr'):
                target_err = write_end
            else:
                target_out = write_end
        command = [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                   '--raw-exec', str((folder / 'EXEC-REQUEST.json').resolve())]
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=inp, stdout=target_out, stderr=target_err,
                                     start_new_session=True, restore_signals=False)
            try:
                rc = child.wait(timeout=LIMITS['wall'])
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed_out = True
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                rc = child.wait(timeout=LIMITS['cleanup'])
            consumed = inp.tell()
            if mode == 'short-stderr':
                os.close(write_end)
                pipes.remove(write_end)
                piece = bytearray()
                while True:
                    data = os.read(read_end, 65536)
                    if not data:
                        break
                    piece.extend(data)
                err.write(piece)
        finally:
            for fd in pipes:
                os.close(fd)
    try:
        os.waitpid(child.pid, os.WNOHANG)
    except ChildProcessError:
        reaped = True
    else:
        reaped = False
    after = elf.read_bytes()
    result = {'command': command, 'payload': str(elf.resolve()), 'returncode': rc,
        'timed_out': timed_out, 'reaped_ECHILD': reaped, 'stdin_consumed': consumed,
        'stdout_hex': (folder / 'stdout.bin').read_bytes().hex(),
        'stderr_hex': (folder / 'stderr.bin').read_bytes().hex(),
        'image_sha256': sha(raw), 'image_after_sha256': sha(after),
        'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started, 'limits': LIMITS,
        'pipe_capacity': capacity, 'preexec_python_ctypes': True,
        'runtime_payload_python_or_ctypes': False,
        'exec_failure': json.loads((folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').read_text())
            if (folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').exists() else None}
    dump(folder / 'OBSERVATION.json', result)
    return result


def reference(program, argv, environment, *, stdin=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False,
              short_capacity=None):
    from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE, READ, LinuxStartupSnapshot, LinuxProcessSignal
    from hepta.hia_program_runtime import execute_program, HIAProgramTrap
    consumed = 0
    stdout = []
    stderr = []
    def provider(request):
        nonlocal consumed
        if request.operation == READ:
            if mode == 'closed-stdin':
                return -9, b''
            data = stdin[consumed:consumed + request.count]
            consumed += len(data)
            return len(data), data
        if mode == 'closed-stdout' and request.fd == 1 or mode == 'closed-stderr' and request.fd == 2:
            return -9, b''
        if mode == 'broken-stderr' and request.fd == 2 or mode == 'broken-stdout' and request.fd == 1:
            if ignored:
                return -32, b''
            raise LinuxProcessSignal(int(signal.SIGPIPE))
        accepted = request.count
        if mode == 'short-stderr' and request.fd == 2:
            assert type(short_capacity) is int and 0 < short_capacity < request.count
            accepted = short_capacity
        (stdout if request.fd == 1 else stderr).append(request.write_bytes[:accepted])
        return accepted, b''
    try:
        result = execute_program(program, 'f0', (b'', bytes(1048576), bytes(1048576)),
            profile=PROFILE, linux_process_startup=LinuxStartupSnapshot(argv, environment),
            linux_process_provider=provider, max_steps=10000000)
        rc = result['values'][0] & 255
    except HIAProgramTrap as exc:
        result = exc.report
        rc = -int(signal.SIGILL)
    except LinuxProcessSignal as exc:
        result = exc.report
        rc = -exc.number
    result.update(expected_stdout_hex=b''.join(stdout).hex(),
        expected_stderr_hex=b''.join(stderr).hex(), stdin_consumed=consumed, process_returncode=rc)
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == '--raw-exec'
    raw_exec(sys.argv[2])

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _function(raw, name):
    found = [node for node in ast.parse(raw).body
             if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name]
    if len(found) != 1:
        raise AssertionError('one complete original function required: ' + name)
    return found[0]


def _fields(value):
    if isinstance(value, ast.AST):
        return (type(value).__name__, tuple((key, _fields(item))
                for key, item in ast.iter_fields(value)))
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return tuple(_fields(item) for item in value)
    return (type(value).__name__, value)

"""Build explicit Linux process compilers/programs from matching current cold B3.

The original caller-pinned development builder remains a separate entry point.
This builder never executes its produced ELF or promotes a default selection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import struct
import sys
import traceback

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program, render_assembly
from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE, require_profile, verify_linux_process_program
from tools.build_hia_linux_process_program import PACK_MAGIC, _elf_structure
from tools.hia_linux_process_cold import (
    CAPACITY, COMPILER_SOURCE, PACKER_SOURCE, ORDINARY_SOURCE,
    admit_cold, capture, check_bindings, compile_bound, decode, digest,
    guard_authority, observation, pin, publish, re_admit_authority, require,
)

TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA = 'hepta.hia.linux-process-cold-toolchain.v1'
TOOLCHAIN_STATUS = 'MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD_LINUX_PROCESS_COMPILER_BUILT'
PROGRAM_SCHEMA = 'hepta.hia.linux-process-cold-program-build.v1'
PROGRAM_STATUS = 'MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD_LINUX_PROCESS_PROGRAM_BUILT'
LABELS = ('process-P1', 'process-P2', 'process-P3', 'ordinary-B3-regression', 'entry-packer')


def _sources():
    return {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
            for name in (COMPILER_SOURCE, ORDINARY_SOURCE, PACKER_SOURCE)}


def _capture_names(folder):
    return {'compiler': folder / 'captured-cold-B3.image.bin',
            COMPILER_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.hepta',
            ORDINARY_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-ordinary-compiler.hepta',
            PACKER_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-entry-packer.hepta'}


def _stages(folder, authority, sources):
    captures = _capture_names(folder)
    records = []
    images = {}
    provider = captures['compiler']
    for label in LABELS[:3]:
        path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, label, provider, sources[COMPILER_SOURCE])
        images[label] = path
        records.append(receipt)
        provider = path
    path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, LABELS[3], provider, sources[ORDINARY_SOURCE])
    images[LABELS[3]] = path
    records.append(receipt)
    path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, LABELS[4], provider, sources[PACKER_SOURCE])
    images[LABELS[4]] = path
    records.append(receipt)
    linux_bytes = [images[label].read_bytes() for label in LABELS[:3]]
    require(linux_bytes[0] == linux_bytes[1] == linux_bytes[2], 'Linux P1/P2/P3 fixed point differs')
    original = Path(authority['compiler']).read_bytes()
    require(captures['compiler'].read_bytes() == original
            and images[LABELS[3]].read_bytes() == original,
            'profile compiler changes the complete ordinary B3 compiler')
    require(all(captures[name].read_bytes() == raw for name, raw in sources.items()),
            'captured compiler/packer sources changed')
    return images, records


def _all_files(folder, exclude=()):
    return [pin(p) for p in sorted(Path(folder).rglob('*'))
            if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(folder)) not in exclude]


def build_toolchain(output, cold_report, *, compiler=None):
    """Five actual original-budget stages, with exact cold and full receipts."""
    authority = admit_cold(cold_report, compiler=compiler)
    sources = _sources()
    require(all(digest(raw) == authority['source_manifest'][name]
                for name, raw in sources.items()), 'compiler/packer capture differs from cold source')
    # Both author assets are ordinary pure HIA. The physical profile remains
    # explicit only for programs compiled by the resulting Linux compiler.
    pure = {name: assemble_program(raw).sha256 for name, raw in sources.items()}
    folder = Path(output).absolute()
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'schema': TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA, 'status': 'FAIL', 'profile': PROFILE,
        'scope': 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD', 'authority': authority,
        'source_manifest': authority['source_manifest'],
        'source_sha256': {name: digest(raw) for name, raw in sources.items()},
        'pure_core_sha256': pure, 'compiler_sha256': authority['compiler_sha256'],
        'cold_report_sha256': authority['cold_report_sha256'],
        'matching_cold': True, 'qualification_complete': False,
        'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False, 'default_activated': False,
        'author_and_supervisor_python': True,
        'compile_seconds': 20, 'output_bytes': CAPACITY, 'workspace_bytes': CAPACITY,
        'stage_labels': list(LABELS), 'stages': []}
    try:
        captures = _capture_names(folder)
        capture(captures['compiler'], Path(authority['compiler']).read_bytes())
        for name, raw in sources.items():
            capture(captures[name], raw)
        provider = captures['compiler']
        for label in LABELS[:3]:
            path, raw, receipt = compile_bound(folder, label, provider, sources[COMPILER_SOURCE], authority)
            report['stages'].append(receipt)
            provider = path
        for label, name in ((LABELS[3], ORDINARY_SOURCE), (LABELS[4], PACKER_SOURCE)):
            path, raw, receipt = compile_bound(folder, label, provider, sources[name], authority)
            report['stages'].append(receipt)
        images, observed = _stages(folder, authority, sources)
        require(observed == report['stages'], 'actual full compiler receipts differ')
        require(_sources() == sources, 'source changed during toolchain build')
        guard_authority(authority)
        report.update(status=TOOLCHAIN_STATUS, inputs_unchanged=True,
            process_P1_P2_P3_equal=True, ordinary_B3_byte_exact=True,
            compiler_image=str(images['process-P3']), packer_image=str(images['entry-packer']),
            image_sha256={name: digest(path.read_bytes()) for name, path in images.items()},
            input_bindings=_all_files(folder))
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', matching_cold=False, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        publish(folder / 'BUILD.json', report)
    return folder / 'BUILD.json'


def admit_toolchain(path, *, authority=None):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    report = decode(raw)
    require(type(report) is dict and report.get('schema') == TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA
            and report.get('status') == TOOLCHAIN_STATUS
            and report.get('scope') == 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
            and report.get('profile') == PROFILE and report.get('matching_cold') is True
            and report.get('qualification_complete') is False
            and report.get('whole_native_delivery_qualified') is False
            and report.get('default_activated') is False,
            'strict cold toolchain record required; development records are not authority')
    fresh = re_admit_authority(report.get('authority'))
    if authority is not None:
        require(fresh == authority, 'toolchain belongs to different cold authority')
    sources = _sources()
    check_bindings(report.get('input_bindings'))
    require(report['input_bindings'] == _all_files(path.parent, exclude=(path.name,)),
            'toolchain file inventory differs')
    images, receipts = _stages(path.parent, fresh, sources)
    require(report.get('source_manifest') == fresh['source_manifest']
            and report.get('source_sha256') == {name: digest(value) for name, value in sources.items()}
            and report.get('pure_core_sha256') == {name: assemble_program(value).sha256 for name, value in sources.items()}
            and report.get('compiler_sha256') == fresh['compiler_sha256']
            and report.get('cold_report_sha256') == fresh['cold_report_sha256']
            and report.get('stage_labels') == list(LABELS) and report.get('stages') == receipts
            and report.get('compiler_image') == str(images['process-P3'])
            and report.get('packer_image') == str(images['entry-packer'])
            and report.get('image_sha256') == {name: digest(p.read_bytes()) for name, p in images.items()}
            and report.get('inputs_unchanged') is True and report.get('process_P1_P2_P3_equal') is True
            and report.get('ordinary_B3_byte_exact') is True
            and type(report.get('compile_seconds')) is int and report['compile_seconds'] == 20
            and type(report.get('output_bytes')) is int and report['output_bytes'] == CAPACITY
            and type(report.get('workspace_bytes')) is int and report['workspace_bytes'] == CAPACITY,
            'actual cold compiler chain or original limits differ')
    guard_authority(fresh)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw, 'toolchain report changed during admission')
    return report


def _publish_executable(path, raw):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb', closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(fd)
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o500)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw and stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == 0o500,
            'published ELF bytes or mode differ')


def build_program(program, output, *, profile, cold_report, compiler=None, toolchain=None):
    """Compile and pack one checked program. Execution is a separate action."""
    require_profile(profile)
    checked = verify_linux_process_program(program)
    source = render_assembly(checked, profile=PROFILE).encode()
    authority = admit_cold(cold_report, compiler=compiler)
    admitted = None if toolchain is None else admit_toolchain(toolchain, authority=authority)
    folder = Path(output).absolute()
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'schema': PROGRAM_SCHEMA, 'status': 'FAIL', 'profile': PROFILE,
        'scope': 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD', 'authority': authority,
        'source_manifest': authority['source_manifest'],
        'program_sha256': checked.sha256, 'source_sha256': digest(source),
        'cold_report_sha256': authority['cold_report_sha256'],
        'matching_cold': True, 'qualification_complete': False,
        'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False, 'default_activated': False,
        'payload_executed': False, 'author_and_supervisor_python': True,
        'compile_seconds': 20, 'output_bytes': CAPACITY, 'workspace_bytes': CAPACITY,
        'stages': []}
    try:
        if admitted is None:
            toolchain = build_toolchain(folder / 'toolchain', cold_report, compiler=authority['compiler'])
            admitted = admit_toolchain(toolchain, authority=authority)
        toolchain_path = Path(toolchain).resolve(strict=True)
        compiler_raw = Path(admitted['compiler_image']).read_bytes()
        packer_raw = Path(admitted['packer_image']).read_bytes()
        local_compiler = folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.image.bin'
        local_packer = folder / 'captured-entry-packer.image.bin'
        capture(local_compiler, compiler_raw)
        capture(local_packer, packer_raw)
        capture(folder / 'program.hepta', source)
        program_path, program_raw, first = compile_bound(folder, 'program', local_compiler, source, authority)
        report['stages'].append(first)
        require(len(program_raw) <= CAPACITY - 1024, 'program leaves no fixed ELF entry space')
        frame = struct.pack('<QQQQ', PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program_raw), 0) + program_raw
        packed_path, elf, second = compile_bound(folder, 'packed', local_packer, frame, authority,
                                                  extension='.elf.bin')
        report['stages'].append(second)
        inspected = _elf_structure(elf, program_raw)
        require(admit_toolchain(toolchain_path, authority=authority) == admitted
                and local_compiler.read_bytes() == compiler_raw and local_packer.read_bytes() == packer_raw
                and (folder / 'program.hepta').read_bytes() == source
                and verify_linux_process_program(checked).canonical_bytes == checked.canonical_bytes,
                'captured program or cold toolchain changed')
        guard_authority(authority)
        destination = folder / 'program.elf'
        _publish_executable(destination, elf)
        report.update(status=PROGRAM_STATUS, inputs_unchanged=True,
            toolchain=pin(toolchain_path), compiler_sha256=digest(compiler_raw),
            packer_sha256=digest(packer_raw), elf_inspection=inspected,
            executable=pin(destination), input_bindings=_all_files(folder))
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', matching_cold=False, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        publish(folder / 'BUILD.json', report)
    return folder / 'BUILD.json'


def admit_program(path, *, authority=None):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    report = decode(raw)
    require(type(report) is dict and report.get('schema') == PROGRAM_SCHEMA
            and report.get('status') == PROGRAM_STATUS
            and report.get('scope') == 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
            and report.get('profile') == PROFILE and report.get('matching_cold') is True
            and report.get('qualification_complete') is False
            and report.get('whole_native_delivery_qualified') is False
            and report.get('default_activated') is False and report.get('payload_executed') is False,
            'strict cold program build required; development records cannot qualify')
    fresh = re_admit_authority(report.get('authority'))
    if authority is not None:
        require(fresh == authority, 'program belongs to different cold source authority')
    folder = path.parent
    check_bindings(report.get('input_bindings'))
    require(report['input_bindings'] == _all_files(folder, exclude=(path.name,)),
            'program file inventory differs')
    tc = report.get('toolchain')
    require(type(tc) is dict and pin(tc['path']) == tc, 'toolchain record identity changed')
    chain = admit_toolchain(tc['path'], authority=fresh)
    source = (folder / 'program.hepta').read_bytes()
    checked = assemble_program(source, profile=PROFILE)
    local_compiler, local_packer = folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.image.bin', folder / 'captured-entry-packer.image.bin'
    require(local_compiler.read_bytes() == Path(chain['compiler_image']).read_bytes()
            and local_packer.read_bytes() == Path(chain['packer_image']).read_bytes(),
            'program uses a different compiler or packer')
    _, program, first = observation(folder, 'program', local_compiler, source)
    frame = struct.pack('<QQQQ', PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program), 0) + program
    _, elf, second = observation(folder, 'packed', local_packer, frame, extension='.elf.bin')
    exe = folder / 'program.elf'
    require(report.get('source_manifest') == fresh['source_manifest']
            and report.get('program_sha256') == checked.sha256 and report.get('source_sha256') == digest(source)
            and report.get('cold_report_sha256') == fresh['cold_report_sha256']
            and report.get('compiler_sha256') == digest(local_compiler.read_bytes())
            and report.get('packer_sha256') == digest(local_packer.read_bytes())
            and report.get('stages') == [first, second]
            and report.get('elf_inspection') == _elf_structure(elf, program)
            and report.get('executable') == pin(exe) and exe.read_bytes() == elf
            and stat.S_IMODE(exe.stat().st_mode) == 0o500
            and report.get('inputs_unchanged') is True
            and type(report.get('compile_seconds')) is int and report['compile_seconds'] == 20
            and type(report.get('output_bytes')) is int and report['output_bytes'] == CAPACITY
            and type(report.get('workspace_bytes')) is int and report['workspace_bytes'] == CAPACITY,
            'actual program receipt, pack frame, ELF or original limit differs')
    guard_authority(fresh)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw, 'program report changed during admission')
    return report


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--cold-report', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compiler', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--profile', choices=[PROFILE])
    parser.add_argument('--toolchain', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.source is None:
        require(args.profile is None and args.toolchain is None, 'toolchain-only arguments cannot select a program')
        path = build_toolchain(args.output, args.cold_report, compiler=args.compiler)
    else:
        require_profile(args.profile)
        checked = assemble_program(args.source.read_bytes(), profile=args.profile)
        path = build_program(checked, args.output, profile=args.profile, cold_report=args.cold_report,
                             compiler=args.compiler, toolchain=args.toolchain)
    print(json.dumps({'build': str(path), 'status': decode(path.read_bytes())['status']}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Fresh current-source cold custody for the explicit Linux process profile.

This hosted qualifier checks original cold authority and actual bounded child
receipts. It grants no authority to a development digest, startup snapshot, or
serialized fixture. The underlying stdio checks and their full source domain
remain required; process inputs add to that domain.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from tools import hia_linux_stdio_cold as _stdio
from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE

CAPACITY = _stdio.CAPACITY
COMPILER_SOURCE = 'examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost_linux_process.hepta'
PACKER_SOURCE = 'examples/hia_bootstrap/linux_process_entry_packer.hepta'
ORDINARY_SOURCE = _stdio.ORDINARY_SOURCE
AUTHORITY_SCHEMA = 'hepta.hia.linux-process-cold-inputs.v1'
RETAINED_INPUTS = 'tests/fixtures/hia_linux_process_retained_controls.json'
RETAINED_INPUTS_SHA256 = '7a308746f98a62627ac1449d9391ad72ab3c17dd9b70c089bf8ca874731e66ba'
PROCESS_SOURCES = (
    COMPILER_SOURCE, PACKER_SOURCE, 'hepta/hia_linux_process.py',
    'tools/generate_hia_selfhost_linux_process.py',
    'tools/generate_hia_linux_process_entry.py',
    'tools/build_hia_linux_process_program.py',
    'tools/hia_linux_process_cold.py', 'tools/build_hia_linux_process_cold.py',
    'tools/qualify_hia_linux_process.py', 'tests/test_hia_linux_process.py',
    'tests/hia_linux_process_programs.py', 'tests/hia_linux_process_cases.py',
    'tests/hia_linux_process_cold_cases.py',
    'tests/hia_linux_process_buffer_observer.py',
    'tests/hia_linux_process_buffer_child.py',
    'tests/hia_linux_process_startup_fault_observer.py',
    'tests/test_hia_linux_process_cold.py', RETAINED_INPUTS,
    'docs/HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_COLD.md',
)
REQUIRED_SOURCES = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*_stdio.REQUIRED_SOURCES, *PROCESS_SOURCES)))
require = _stdio.require
digest = _stdio.digest
decode = _stdio.decode
wire = _stdio.wire
publish = _stdio.publish
pin = _stdio.pin
check_bindings = _stdio.check_bindings
outer_shape = _stdio.outer_shape
child_receipt = _stdio.child_receipt
observation = _stdio.observation
capture = _stdio.capture


def retained_inputs():
    raw = (ROOT / RETAINED_INPUTS).read_bytes()
    require(digest(raw) == RETAINED_INPUTS_SHA256, 'complete retained process inputs changed')
    value = decode(raw)
    require(value.get('schema') == 'hepta.hia.linux-process-retained-controls.v1'
            and value.get('native_or_cold_qualification') is False,
            'retained observations are inputs, not current-cold authority')
    return value


def admit_required_sources(sources, *, root=ROOT, names=REQUIRED_SOURCES):
    _stdio.admit_required_sources(sources, root=root, names=names)


def admit_cold(cold_report, *, compiler=None):
    authority = _stdio.admit_cold(cold_report, compiler=compiler)
    admit_required_sources(authority['source_manifest'])
    authority = {**authority, 'schema': AUTHORITY_SCHEMA, 'physical_profile': PROFILE}
    guard_authority(authority)
    return authority


def guard_authority(authority):
    require(type(authority) is dict and authority.get('schema') == AUTHORITY_SCHEMA
            and authority.get('physical_profile') == PROFILE,
            'explicit process current-cold authority required')
    _stdio.guard_authority(authority)
    admit_required_sources(authority['source_manifest'])


def re_admit_authority(authority):
    require(type(authority) is dict and authority.get('schema') == AUTHORITY_SCHEMA
            and authority.get('physical_profile') == PROFILE,
            'fresh original process cold admission required')
    fresh = admit_cold(authority['cold_report'], compiler=authority['compiler'])
    require(fresh == authority, 'serialized process fixture differs from fresh cold authority')
    return fresh


def compile_bound(folder, label, provider, payload, authority, *, extension='.image.bin'):
    from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import compile_stage
    guard_authority(authority)
    before = Path(provider).read_bytes()
    path, returned = compile_stage(Path(folder), label, Path(provider), payload,
                                   output_extension=extension)
    actual_path, produced, observed = observation(folder, label, provider, payload, extension=extension)
    require(path == actual_path and returned == observed and Path(provider).read_bytes() == before,
            'actual process compiler stage or provider changed: ' + label)
    guard_authority(authority)
    return path, produced, observed


def probe_observation(directory, label, provider, payload):
    """Read a rejecting or successful original compiler probe without a build claim."""
    from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import CHILD
    folder, provider = Path(directory), Path(provider)
    source_path = folder / (label + '.input.bin')
    output_path = folder / (label + '.output.bin')
    request = decode((folder / (label + '.request.json')).read_bytes())
    receipt = decode((folder / (label + '.receipt.json')).read_bytes())
    child = decode((folder / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_bytes())
    provider_raw = provider.read_bytes()
    output = output_path.read_bytes()
    expected = {'capacity': CAPACITY, 'format': 'flat-x86-64',
        'image': str(provider.resolve()), 'image_sha256': digest(provider_raw),
        'output': str(output_path.resolve()), 'source': str(source_path.resolve()),
        'source_sha256': digest(payload), 'workspace_fill': 0, 'workspace_size': CAPACITY}
    host_fields = _stdio.RECEIPT_HOST_FIELDS - {'produced_bytes', 'produced_image', 'produced_sha256'}
    require(type(request) is dict and wire(request) == wire(expected)
            and all(type(request[key]) is int for key in ('capacity', 'workspace_fill', 'workspace_size'))
            and type(payload) is bytes and source_path.read_bytes() == payload,
            'probe request differs from the actual captured input: ' + label)
    require(type(child) is dict and set(child) == _stdio.CHILD_FIELDS
            and type(receipt) is dict and set(receipt) == _stdio.CHILD_FIELDS | host_fields
            and all(wire(child[key]) == wire(receipt[key]) for key in child),
            'actual child stdout differs from full probe receipt: ' + label)
    require((folder / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_bytes() == b''
            and receipt.get('case') == label and receipt.get('status') == 'returned'
            and type(receipt.get('abi_status')) is int and receipt['abi_status'] == 0
            and type(receipt.get('core_u32')) is int and 0 <= receipt['core_u32'] <= 0xffffffff
            and type(receipt.get('result_u64')) is int and receipt['result_u64'] == receipt['core_u32']
            and receipt.get('return_encoding') == 'zero-extended-u32'
            and receipt.get('forbidden_compiler_modules_loaded') == []
            and receipt.get('format') == 'flat-x86-64'
            and receipt.get('artifact_sha256') == receipt.get('image_sha256') == digest(provider_raw)
            and receipt.get('source_sha256') == receipt.get('input_sha256') == digest(payload)
            and type(receipt.get('input_bytes')) is int and receipt['input_bytes'] == len(payload)
            and receipt.get('source_unchanged') is True
            and receipt.get('runner_sha256') == digest(CHILD.read_bytes())
            and len(output) == CAPACITY and receipt.get('output_sha256') == digest(output),
            'actual probe outcome/provider/source differs: ' + label)
    limits = receipt.get('limits')
    require(limits == {'address_bytes': 268435456, 'core_dumpable': False,
        'cpu_seconds': 10, 'output_capacity': CAPACITY, 'stack_bytes': 8388608,
        'workspace_bytes': CAPACITY} and limits['core_dumpable'] is False
        and all(type(value) is int for key,value in limits.items() if key != 'core_dumpable'),
        'original probe resource limits changed: ' + label)
    return receipt, output

_SOURCE_PATH_MISSING = object()


def _source_code_constants(value):
    """Normalize only exact immutable code constants, without foreign equality."""
    if type(value) is tuple:
        result = []
        for item in value:
            item = _source_code_constants(item)
            if item is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING:
                return item
            result.append(item)
        return tuple(result)
    if value is None or type(value) in (str, bytes, int, bool, float):
        return type(value), value
    return _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING


def _source_same_protocol(function, reference):
    if type(function) is not _source_types.FunctionType:
        return False
    actual, expected = function.__code__, reference.__code__
    # Names/qualnames, source positions and docstring spelling do not govern
    # these fixed binary I/O and lexical path operations. Executable bytecode,
    # exception regions, constants and signatures do.
    actual_constants = _source_code_constants(actual.co_consts[1:])
    expected_constants = _source_code_constants(expected.co_consts[1:])
    if actual_constants is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING or expected_constants is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING:
        return False
    actual_kw, expected_kw = function.__kwdefaults__, reference.__kwdefaults__
    if actual_kw is not None:
        if type(actual_kw) is not dict or any(type(key) is not str for key in actual_kw):
            return False
        actual_kw = _source_code_constants(tuple(sorted(actual_kw.items())))
        if actual_kw is _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING:
            return False
    if expected_kw is not None:
        expected_kw = _source_code_constants(tuple(sorted(expected_kw.items())))

def _source_static_member(cls, name):
    for parent in cls.__mro__:
        namespace = parent.__dict__
        if name in namespace:
            return namespace[name]
    return _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING


def _source_capture_protocol():
    # This is an immutable protocol identity, never a path/file/digest cache.
    # Unknown runtimes or pre-import provider replacements use the original
    # public Path protocol. Both reviewed read_bytes buffer modes are explicit.
    path_class, concrete = _source_pathlib.Path, _source_pathlib.PosixPath
    if type(path_class) is not type or type(concrete) is not type:
        return None
    if type(_source_io) is not _source_types.ModuleType:
        return None
    opened = _source_io.__dict__.get('open')
    if (type(opened) is not _source_types.BuiltinFunctionType
            or opened.__module__ != '_io' or opened.__name__ != 'open'
            or type(sha256) is not _source_types.BuiltinFunctionType
            or sha256.__module__ != '_hashlib' or sha256.__name__ != 'openssl_sha256'):
        return None
    functions = []
    names = ('read_bytes', 'open', '__truediv__', 'as_posix', 'relative_to',
             '__fspath__', '__str__', 'joinpath', 'with_segments')
    buffering = None
    for name in names:
        function = _source_static_member(concrete, name)
        matches = [profile for profile in (_SourcePathProtocol312, _SourcePathProtocol314)
                   if _source_same_protocol(function, profile.__dict__[name])]
        if not matches:
            return None
        if name == 'read_bytes':
            buffering = -1 if _SourcePathProtocol312 in matches else 0
        kw = function.__kwdefaults__
        if kw is not None and (type(kw) is not dict or any(type(k) is not str for k in kw)):
            return None
        functions.append((name, function, function.__code__, function.__defaults__,
                          kw, tuple(kw.items()) if kw is not None else ()))
    if _source_static_member(concrete, 'open').__globals__.get('io') is not _source_io:
        return None
    classes = []
    for cls in concrete.__mro__:
        if cls is object:
            continue
        namespace = cls.__dict__
        # Reject foreign descriptors/methods before freezing their identities.
        for value in namespace.values():
            function = value.__func__ if type(value) in (classmethod, staticmethod) else value
            if type(function) is _source_types.FunctionType:
                if (function.__globals__ is not _source_pathlib.__dict__
                        or function.__code__.co_filename != _source_pathlib.__file__):
                    return None
        classes.append((cls, len(namespace), tuple((name, namespace.get(name, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING))
                                                 for name in names)))
    return (path_class, concrete, opened, sha256, buffering, tuple(classes), tuple(functions))


_SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL = _source_capture_protocol()


def _source_protocol_current(root):
    protocol = _SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL
    if protocol is None or Path is not protocol[0] or type(root) is not protocol[1]:
        return False
    if (type(_source_io) is not _source_types.ModuleType
            or _source_io.__dict__.get('open') is not protocol[2]
            or sha256 is not protocol[3]):
        return False
    for cls, length, members in protocol[5]:
        namespace = cls.__dict__
        if len(namespace) != length:
            return False
        for name, value in members:
            if namespace.get(name, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING) is not value:
                return False
    for name, function, code, defaults, kw, items in protocol[6]:
        if function.__code__ is not code or function.__defaults__ is not defaults:
            return False
        if function.__kwdefaults__ is not kw:
            return False
        if kw is not None:
            if len(kw) != len(items) or any(type(key) is not str for key in kw):
                return False
            if any(kw.get(key, _SOURCE_PATH_MISSING) is not value for key, value in items):
                return False
    return _source_static_member(protocol[1], 'open').__globals__.get('io') is _source_io


def _source_relative_name(path, root, prefix):
    # A foreign path executes the original expression in the caller's set
    # comprehension; this helper neither calls nor retains its protocol.
    if type(path) is not type(root) or not _source_protocol_current(root):
        return None
    full = path.as_posix()
    if prefix:
        if full.startswith(prefix) and len(full) > len(prefix):
            return full[len(prefix):]
    elif not full.startswith('/'):
        return full
    return None


def _source_lexical_read(root, relative, prefix):
    # Recheck mutable public providers at each read, including replacements
    # introduced by an earlier file's audit hook/hash operation. Exact bytes
    # leave this frame before sha256; close always precedes hashing.
    if (type(relative) is str and relative and not relative.startswith('/')
            and not relative.endswith('/') and '//' not in relative
            and relative != '.' and not relative.startswith('./')
            and not relative.endswith('/.') and '/./' not in relative
            and _source_protocol_current(root)):
        with _source_io.open(prefix + relative, 'rb', buffering=_SOURCE_PATH_PROTOCOL[4]) as stream:
            return stream.read()
    return (root / relative).read_bytes()


def file_digests(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    # The original expression remains the full provider fallback. No path
    # inventory, source bytes or digest survives any invocation of this API.
    if (not _source_protocol_current(root) or type(SOURCE_FILES) is not tuple
            or any(type(name) is not str for name in SOURCE_FILES)):
        paths = sorted(set(SOURCE_FILES) | {
            p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root / "hepta").rglob("*.py")
        })
        return {path: sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}
    declared = set(SOURCE_FILES)
    root_name = root.as_posix()
    prefix = '' if root_name == '.' else root_name if root_name.endswith('/') else root_name + '/'
    paths = sorted(declared | {
        name if (name := _source_relative_name(p, root, prefix)) is not None
        else p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        for p in (root / "hepta").rglob("*.py")
    })
    return {path: sha256(_source_lexical_read(root, path, prefix)).hexdigest() for path in paths}
